title: Dil mein basa liya hai tujhko

lines.text: Dil mein basa liya hai tujhko,
Teri tarif ho, teri tarif ho,
Mere liye tu mara, mere liye tu gada, (2)
Yeshu tu kaisa piya, lahu se mol liya |
Vandana ho ab teri, aaradhana ho ab teri, (2)
Bhakti karoon main teri, aasha yahi Naasari |
Tu hai sakoon mera, tu hi hai meri shifa, (2)
Jeevan basar saath ho, yahi hai meri dua |

chords:
[Verse 1]
Dil mein basa liya hai tujhko,
Rooh mein samā liya tujhko |

[CHORUS]
Teri tarif ho, teri tarif ho,
Teri tarif ho, ai Yeshu |

[Verse 2]
Mere liye tu mara, mere liye tu gada, (2)
Yeshu tu kaisa piya, lahu se mol liya |
..repeat

[Verse 3]
Vandana ho ab teri, aaradhana ho ab teri, (2)
Bhakti karoon main teri, aasha yahi Naasari |
..repeat

[Verse 4]
Tu hai sakoon mera, tu hi hai meri shifa, (2)
Jeevan basar saath ho, yahi hai meri dua |
..repeat

[Outro]
https://youtu.be/66mTDr_Qq78
